en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a central European town hall building on a sloping square. The multi-storey structure has a mansard roof, dormer windows, and a clock tower with a cupola. A crowd of people stands on the steps in front of the entrance. Surrounding are narrow streets lined with multi-storey townhouses, and church spires rise in the distant background. German titles are printed at the top left and bottom right of the card.
